commands: awk '/^sshd/ { n++; if (n <= 3) print } END { if (n == 0) print "ABSENT" }' /etc/pam.conf
blurb: This check verifies that AIX remote sshd uses the PowerSC PAM MFA stack (pam_ckfile, pam_permission, pam_pmfa). When the first three sshd lines of /etc/pam.conf do not match that stack, remote connections can authenticate without Multi Factor Authentication.
